paper.title_en: Exploring Ultralight Dark Matter Self-Coupling via the Gravitational Wave Background
paper.abstract_en: Supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary mergers are a primary source of the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in the nanohertz band, now being actively probed by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs). We investigate how ultralight dark matter (ULDM) with a quartic self-interaction, forming solitonic cores around SMBHs, modifies the SGWB through dynamical friction on the inspiralling binary. Solving the Gross--Pitaevskii--Poisson (GPP) equations numerically for halo masses $M_{\rm halo}\sim 10^{13}\,M_{\odot}$, we compute self-consistent solitonic density profiles across a range of dimensionless self-coupling parameters $\hatλ$, covering both attractive and repulsive self-interactions. We find that soliton-induced dynamical friction imprints a characteristic suppression feature in the GW strain spectrum, whose frequency location and depth are sensitive to both the ULDM mass $m$ and the coupling $\hatλ$. For SMBH masses $M_{\bullet}\sim 10^{8.5}\,M_{\odot}$ and ULDM masses in the range $m\sim(3\times10^{-22}-2\times10^{-21})\,\mathrm{eV}$, current PTA observations from NANOGrav, EPTA, and PPTA may place qualitative limits on the attractive and repulsive self-coupling of ULDM particles. ULDM masses exceeding ${\sim}\,1.6\times10^{-21}\,\mathrm{eV}$ are independently excluded by soliton accretion-timescale constraints. These results demonstrate that the nanohertz GW spectrum provides a complementary probe of ULDM self-interactions, operating in a regime distinct from conventional particle-scattering or rotation-curve analyses.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该研究利用脉冲星计时阵列探测超轻暗物质自相互作用，结合数值求解GPP方程，提出了对引力波谱的新预言，主题高度相关且方法严谨。
decision.title_zh: 通过引力波背景探索超轻暗物质的自耦合
decision.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）双星并合是纳赫兹频段随机引力波背景（SGWB）的主要来源，目前正被脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）积极探测。我们研究了具有四次自相互作用的超轻暗物质（ULDM）在SMBH周围形成孤子核，如何通过动力学摩擦对旋近双星产生影响，从而修改SGWB。对晕质量$M_{\rm halo}\sim 10^{13}\,M_{\odot}$，我们数值求解Gross--Pitaevskii--Poisson（GPP）方程，在一系列无量纲自耦合参数$\hatλ$范围内计算了自洽的孤子密度分布，涵盖了吸引和排斥自相互作用。我们发现孤子诱导的动力学摩擦在引力波应变谱中印下了特征抑制特征，其频率位置和深度对ULDM质量$m$和耦合$\hatλ$都敏感。对于SMBH质量$M_{\bullet}\sim 10^{8.5}\,M_{\odot}$和ULDM质量在$m\sim(3\times10^{-22}-2\times10^{-21})\,\mathrm{eV}$范围内，来自NANOGrav、EPTA和PPTA的当前PTA观测可能对ULDM粒子的吸引和排斥自耦合给出定性限制。超过${\sim}\,1.6\times10^{-21}\,\mathrm{eV}$的ULDM质量被孤子吸积时间尺度约束独立排除。这些结果表明，纳赫兹引力波谱为ULDM自相互作用提供了互补的探测手段，其工作区间不同于传统的粒子散射或旋转曲线分析。
